video_title: Hornets vs 76ers: Moussa Diabate Postgame Media Availability | 10/31/2026

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on the Hornets' fourth-quarter execution struggles
quotes.excerpt: It really comes down to paying attention to details, being able to execute what Coach tells us to execute.
quotes.quote: It really comes down to paying attention to details, being able to execute what Coach tells us to execute. I think we had a couple of times where we kind of forgot ourselves, maybe felt rushed because of the moment. I don't know, I have to watch film again. I'm not too sure.
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate says the Hornets struggled with late game execution against the 76ers because they felt rushed and lost focus on the details

structured.context: Moussa Diabate discusses the Hornets' fourth-quarter execution struggles following their game against the 76ers.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on the team's lack of maturity in closing games
quotes.excerpt: We were up, we should have been more mature at the end of the game.
quotes.quote: Obviously we were up, I don't know to tell how long, but there is pretty much a point where they started going on a run. I think it was pretty much things that I feel like we could have avoided. They were the guys that were in a rush, you know. At the end of the day, we were up, we should have been more mature at the end of the game and like I said, executing. I think there is a couple of times where we messed up execution and yeah, I mean, you know, that's always something that you want to be able to apply, right, especially at the end of the game is very, very important. Good teams is always going to punish you when you're not executing the right way.
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate says the Hornets need to be more mature in closing out games after failing to hold a lead against Philadelphia

structured.context: Moussa Diabate reflects on the team's lack of maturity and poor execution during the final moments of the loss to the 76ers.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on his approach to rebounding and ball security
quotes.excerpt: For me it was just more so like I think a couple of times where the ball just slipped out of my hand.
quotes.quote: For me it was just more so like I think a couple of times where the ball just slipped out of my hand, man. Yeah, that's really what I saw. I didn't really pay attention to what they were doing really. I just think a couple of times where I did have the ball in my hand, especially at one time at the end of the game, yeah, I should have, I should have, I don't know, went with two hands or something. I don't know, but yeah, I don't know, I didn't see it. For me it was just, you know, go for another rebound and like I said, end of the game, I didn't really think that, you know, we got to be even more precise and even more so go with intent.
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate reflects on his late game ball security issues and says he needs to go with more intent and use two hands on rebounds

structured.context: Moussa Diabate explains his ball security and rebounding errors during the final minutes of the game.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on maintaining confidence during the losing streak
quotes.excerpt: It's a long season, obviously it's not the end of the world.
quotes.quote: To be honest, I mean, you know, we got to keep going. It's a long season, obviously it's not the end of the world. We had a terrible start at the beginning of the year last year as well, so right now we're in good pace. I think that we, there's a lot of good things that we've been doing, and yeah, like I said, we're playing great teams, our schedule has been hell of a schedule, we're still missing players, there's so much that goes with it. And like I said, I'm, I'm, I'm, I'm very confident with what the coach is and everybody has in mind and what they're trying to do and like I said, we keep on applying pressure, it's going to be all right. I'm, I'm a very, very firm believer of that.
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate remains confident in the Hornets despite their early season struggles noting the team is still missing players and playing a tough schedule

structured.context: Moussa Diabate expresses confidence in the team's direction and coaching staff despite the current losing streak.
